maintenance.heading: Maintenance tools
maintenance.subtitle: Operations that change many records at once. Each asks for a confirmation before it runs.
maintenance.empty: No maintenance tool is available to you.

credits.heading: Recalculate credits
credits.description: Recomputes every member's balance from the credit ledger and repairs any that differ. It also runs daily.
credits.inputs: No input: it covers every member.
credits.warning: This queues a recount of every balance.

promotions.heading: Run promotions
promotions.description: Evaluates every member against every active promotion now. It also runs daily.
promotions.inputs: No input: it covers every member and every active promotion.
promotions.warning: This queues a sweep that may move members between groups.

awards.heading: Run awards
awards.description: Evaluates every member against every active award that has criteria. It also runs daily.
awards.inputs: No input: it covers every member and every active award.
awards.warning: This queues a sweep that may grant awards and pay their credits.

spam.heading: Spam cleanup
spam.description: Bans a member and queues the removal of all their content.
spam.inputs: Input: the member and, optionally, a reason.
spam.reasonHelp: Optional. Kept in the moderator log.
spam.warning: This bans {name} and queues the cleanup of everything they posted. It cannot be undone from here.
spam.pick: Choose a member to enable this tool.

result.queued: Queued. It runs in the background.
result.notQueued: The backend did not queue it.
result.spamQueued: Queued as job {jobId}. The ban and the cleanup run in the background.

errors.operation: That is not a maintenance operation.

moderatorLog.heading: Moderator log
moderatorLog.subtitle: What moderators and administrators did, newest first. You see the entries the backend allows you to read.
moderatorLog.actionHint: Type the start of an action id, shown under each action: permission. or node.moderator
moderatorLog.partialTitle: Nothing on this stretch of the log
moderatorLog.partialDescription: The log is searched a stretch at a time and this one had no match. Continue to the next stretch.
moderatorLog.rejected: The action filter was not accepted: {message}

promotionLog.heading: Promotion log
promotionLog.subtitle: Automatic and manual promotion changes, newest first.

creditLedger.heading: Credit ledger
creditLedger.subtitle: Every credit movement, newest first, or those of one member.

purchases.heading: Shop purchases
purchases.subtitle: What was bought, newest first, or by one buyer.

tasks.heading: Background tasks
tasks.subtitle: The state of the queued work: sweeps, recounts and cleanups.
